name: Liverpool
description: Mexican department store chain with an online store. Its free-shipping page states that purchases ship free to the whole country and describes delivery hours and same-day express where available.
description_es: Cadena mexicana de tiendas departamentales con tienda en línea. Su página de envío gratis indica que las compras tienen envío gratis a todo el país y describe horarios de entrega y envío express el mismo día donde esté disponible.

ships_to.notes: Free-shipping page says products are shipped across the country; express same-day delivery depends on the nearest store.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Homepage links a store finder; pickup of online orders is not confirmed on the pages read.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

shopping_notes: Spanish-language store; also lists third-party seller shops.

sources.supports: nationwide free shipping, delivery hours, same-day express
